################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the convergence of the models 
################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
library(colorspace)
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
dirs <- lapply(dirs, function(x) paste0("../", x))
```

# Check convergence of the photoperiod models 
```{r}
# Check that Rhats < 1
rhats <- bind_rows(lapply(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$rhats}"), full.names = TRUE), 
                                     "all", negate = TRUE), readRDS)) %>%
  group_by(mod) %>%
  filter(Rhat == max(Rhat)) %>%
  mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 1),
         Rhat_cond = Rhat == 1) %>%
  select(mod, Rhat_cond)

rhats

# Save it 
saveRDS(rhats, glue("{dirs$rhats}/all_rhats.rds"))

# Check which coefficients were problematic for models with Rhats > 1 
bind_rows(lapply(filter(rhats, Rhat_cond == FALSE)$mod, 
                 function(x) readRDS(glue("{dirs$rhats}/rhats_{x}")))) %>%
  mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 1)) %>%
  filter(Rhat != 1) %>%
  select(mod, coef, Rhat)

# Multi dtpw 4 (not a problem)
# Multi hib-men 2, 3, 4, 6 (lack of data, nothing to do)
# Multi ipv 3 (not a problem)
# Multi opv cs, 2, 3, 4, 6 (lack of data, nothing to do)
# Multi strep all (vac conc and vac name)
# Multi dtpa all (Tetanus seems to be the problem)
```
